name: Bug report
about: Reproducible native P.T. iPad build or gameplay problem
title: ''
labels: ''

---

## Build identity

Repository commit, upstream commit, patch/source-tree hash, application build number, iPad model, iPadOS version, Xcode version. For build issues include the selected bundle ID without signing credentials.

## Reproduction

Exact steps, floor/loop/checkpoint, touch or controller, expected and observed behavior. State whether the app was in the foreground and whether this reproduces on native macOS.

## Evidence and verification

List local commands and results. Distinguish built/signed/installed/launched/playable/accepted. For performance include presented-frame duration, loading exclusion and p95 interval.

Attach only redacted relevant diagnostics. Do not upload original game data, package files, credentials, profiles, model downloads or private recordings.
